auth_details: AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) with IAM credentials; no simple API key. Use AWS access key/secret or temporary STS credentials. Service name is bedrock for control plane and bedrock-runtime for InvokeModel/Converse.
free_tier_limits: AWS Free Tier: limited free model invocation for eligible new accounts on select models (token/request caps vary by model and change over time; see AWS Free Tier and Bedrock pricing).
paid_plans: Pay-per-token and provisioned throughput; model- and region-specific. See AWS Bedrock pricing.
rate_limits: Per model and region via AWS Service Quotas (e.g. requests per minute, tokens per minute); see Bedrock quotas docs. Not a single global limit.
description: Amazon Bedrock is a fully managed AWS service for invoking foundation models (Anthropic Claude, Amazon Titan, Meta Llama, and others) through a unified API with AWS SigV4 authentication. Runtime endpoints are regional under bedrock-runtime.
